_comment: Source of truth for chaos (organic fault injection) trigger definitions. vm/sweep-chaos.sh reads this file. Each trigger defines a host-side or guest-side fault injection scenario that may produce a real BSOD through actual failure conditions, unlike the synthetic KeBugCheckEx triggers in trigger-methods.json. Scripts read this file; do not duplicate these entries elsewhere.

nmi-inject.name: NMI injection
nmi-inject.note: Delivers a hardware NMI to the guest vCPU via virsh inject-nmi. VERIFIED 2026-08-26: Windows Server 2025 handles the NMI gracefully without bug-checking. The HAL NMI handler absorbs the interrupt.

balloon-squeeze.name: Memory balloon squeeze under load
balloon-squeeze.note: Shrinks guest memory from 8 GB to 1 GB via virtio balloon while the guest allocates memory. VERIFIED 2026-08-26: Windows Server 2025 memory manager handles the pressure gracefully; no BSOD produced.

storage-hotremove.name: Boot disk hot-remove during I/O
storage-hotremove.note: Removes the boot disk (vda) while the guest is doing I/O. VERIFIED 2026-08-26: virtio-blk hot-unplug is clean; Windows continues from cached pages and the guest stays up. No BSOD produced.

network-toggle.name: Network link toggle under load
network-toggle.guestWorkload: 1..10000 | ForEach-Object { try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://10.0.2.2 -TimeoutSec 1 -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {} }
network-toggle.note: Toggles the virtio-net link down then up during network I/O. VERIFIED 2026-08-26: netkvm handles disconnect gracefully as expected; no BSOD. Resilience validated.

vcpu-hotremove.name: vCPU hot-remove
vcpu-hotremove.note: Reduces vCPUs from 4 to 1 while the guest is running. VERIFIED 2026-08-26: Domain CPU topology (4 sockets, no hotpluggable vCPUs) prevents hot-remove; virsh setvcpus fails with 'failed to find appropriate hotpluggable vcpus'. Requires maxvcpus > vcpus in domain XML for hotplug.

verifier-lowres.name: Driver Verifier Low Resources Simulation
verifier-lowres.guestWorkload: Get-ChildItem C:\ -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; Get-Process | Out-Null; Get-Service | Out-Null; ipconfig /all | Out-Null
verifier-lowres.note: VERIFIED 2026-08-26: VM crashed at 356s. Dirty shutdown confirmed (System/6008). LiveKernelEvent code 0x1a8 logged but NO traditional BugCheck System/1001 event. No crash dump written. The crash bypassed the normal crash dump mechanism, revealing a detection gap: the detector must also check LiveKernelEvent and 6008 dirty shutdown events.

verifier-forced-pending.name: Driver Verifier Forced Pending I/O
verifier-forced-pending.note: Runs with Driver Verifier Forced Pending I/O + IRP Logging enabled. Stresses virtio driver IRP handling paths by forcing asynchronous I/O completion.

blkdeviotune.name: Block I/O throttle to near-zero
blkdeviotune.note: Throttles disk I/O to near-zero via virsh blkdeviotune while the guest performs heavy reads. VERIFIED 2026-08-26: I/O throttle makes SSH unresponsive (false crash detection) but does NOT produce a BSOD. Framebuffer capture confirmed the VM stays at the lock screen. The throttle must be removed before virsh reset or the VM hangs on reboot.

blkdebug-config.name: QEMU blkdebug read error injection
blkdebug-config.note: Injects actual I/O errors via QEMU blkdebug driver. Requires manual domain XML modification with qemu:commandline namespace to wrap the disk in a blkdebug driver. See src/data/blkdebug-read-errors.conf for the configuration. The sweep script skips this trigger unless the domain is pre-configured.

enlightenment-no-tlbflush-ipi.name: Hyper-V without tlbflush+ipi enlightenments
enlightenment-no-tlbflush-ipi.guestWorkload: 1..50 | ForEach-Object { Start-Job -ScriptBlock { Get-Process | Out-Null } | Out-Null }; Get-Job | Wait-Job -Timeout 60 | Out-Null
enlightenment-no-tlbflush-ipi.note: Boots with tlbflush and ipi enlightenments disabled (the validated HYPERVISOR_ERROR mitigation). VERIFIED 2026-08-26: stable under workload for 627s. Mitigation confirmed sufficient.

enlightenment-no-vapic.name: Hyper-V without vapic enlightenment
enlightenment-no-vapic.guestWorkload: 1..50 | ForEach-Object { Start-Job -ScriptBlock { Get-Process | Out-Null } | Out-Null }; Get-Job | Wait-Job -Timeout 60 | Out-Null
enlightenment-no-vapic.note: Boots with vapic enlightenment disabled. VERIFIED 2026-08-26: stable under workload for 545s. Low risk classification in host-signals.json confirmed.

enlightenment-minimal.name: Hyper-V minimal enlightenments
enlightenment-minimal.guestWorkload: 1..50 | ForEach-Object { Start-Job -ScriptBlock { Get-Process | Out-Null } | Out-Null }; Get-Job | Wait-Job -Timeout 60 | Out-Null
enlightenment-minimal.note: Boots with only essential Hyper-V enlightenments (relaxed, vpindex, runtime, synic, reset, frequencies, spinlocks). VERIFIED 2026-08-26: stable under workload for 522s. Maximum enlightenment reduction is viable.
